articles.title: House Finance panel chair says regulator actions on crypto ‘fall short’ of CLARITY bill
articles.snippet: Representative French Hill hopes lawmakers could pass a cryptocurrency market structure bill before the next session of Congress in 2027 as SEC and CFTC actions weren’t sufficient.

articles.title: US Government Moves $1 Billion in Bitcoin Seized From Bitfinex Hacker
articles.snippet: A government wallet holding Bitcoin seized from the Bitfinex hacker sent 12,267 BTC to a new, unlabeled address, according to Arkham data.

articles.title: US Government Moves $103 Million in Seized Bitcoin and BNB, But Hasn't Said Why
articles.snippet: Government-labeled wallets sent 833.6 BTC to Coinbase Prime deposit addresses and shuffled 40,285 BNB. No sale is confirmed, but the stash behind it is the largest any government holds in Arkham's ranking.
